request: Set up PCR reactions for 8 DNA samples in a 96-well PCR plate. Each reaction is 20 ul of master mix plus 5 ul of sample. The master mix is in a 1.5 ml tube and the samples are in 1.5 ml tubes.
I have 24 genomic DNA samples in a tube rack and one tube of 2x PCR master mix with primers already added. Make 25 ul reactions in a PCR plate: 12.5 ul master mix, 10.5 ul water, 2 ul DNA.
Prepare a 96-well PCR plate where every well gets 18 ul of master mix from a reservoir and 2 ul of template from the matching well of a 96-well sample plate.

Set up a qPCR plate for 6 cDNA samples, each in triplicate, 10 ul reactions: 8 ul of SYBR master mix with primers and 2 ul of cDNA. Samples are in PCR strip tubes on an aluminium block, master mix is in a 2 ml tube.
Make a qPCR standard curve: a 5-point 1:10 dilution series of a plasmid standard in water, then load each point in triplicate into a qPCR plate with 15 ul master mix and 5 ul of the diluted standard.
Colony PCR prep: distribute 20 ul of PCR mix into 16 wells of a PCR plate, then add 1 ul from each of 16 colony resuspensions that are in a second 96-well plate.

Assemble PCR reactions from separate components for 12 samples: 10 ul buffer mix, 0.5 ul polymerase, 1 ul forward primer, 1 ul reverse primer, 10.5 ul water and 2 ul template per 25 ul reaction. Components are in 1.5 ml tubes on a cold block.
Do a 1:2 serial dilution of a drug stock across one row of a 96-well plate, 12 points, 100 ul final volume per well, diluting into PBS from a reservoir.
Make 10-fold serial dilutions of 4 bacterial cultures, 6 dilution steps each, in a 96-well plate, 180 ul of saline plus 20 ul transferred at each step. Cultures are in 15 ml tubes.
Prepare a BSA standard curve for a Bradford assay: 8 concentrations from 2 mg/ml down by 1:2 steps in water, 50 ul each in a 96-well plate, from a 2 mg/ml BSA stock tube.

For an MIC assay, serially dilute 3 antibiotics 1:2 down the columns of a 96-well plate (8 points each) in growth medium from a reservoir, 100 ul per well, then add 100 ul of bacterial culture from the reservoir to every well.
Add samples to an ELISA plate: 100 ul from each of 40 serum samples in a 96-well source plate into the matching wells of the coated ELISA plate, plus 8 standards from tubes into column 12.

Run the wash and detection steps of an ELISA on a full 96-well plate: remove the liquid from every well to a waste reservoir, wash 3 times with 300 ul wash buffer, add 100 ul detection antibody, wait 60 minutes, wash 3 times again, then add 100 ul TMB substrate.
Dilute 16 plasma samples 1:100 in assay diluent in two steps using an intermediate plate, then transfer 100 ul of each final dilution in duplicate to an ELISA plate.

Bradford assay for 20 protein samples in duplicate: 5 ul of each sample from 1.5 ml tubes into a flat 96-well plate, then 250 ul of Bradford reagent from a reservoir to every well used, including 8 wells of BSA standards that are already in the plate.

Normalize 24 DNA samples to 10 ng/ul in 50 ul. The sample concentrations are: 85, 120, 44, 67, 210, 95, 33, 150, 78, 60, 101, 55, 190, 72, 48, 130, 88, 25, 64, 110, 39, 175, 92, 58 ng/ul. Samples are in a 96-well plate; add water from a reservoir and the right volume of each sample into a new plate.
Pool 5 ul from each of 48 indexed sequencing libraries in a 96-well plate into a single 1.5 ml tube.
Cherrypick 10 ul from these wells of a source plate into consecutive wells of a destination plate starting at A1: B3, C7, D1, A12, H6, E5, F9, G2, B11, C4.
Fill a 96-well deep well plate with 500 ul of LB medium per well from a reservoir, then inoculate each well with 5 ul from the matching well of a 96-well glycerol stock plate.
Aliquot 50 ul of a protein stock from a 15 ml tube into 48 PCR strip tubes on an aluminium block.
Do a 1.8x AMPure bead cleanup of 8 PCR products (50 ul each) in a PCR plate on the magnetic module: add beads, bind, two 80% ethanol washes, dry, and elute in 30 ul of water into a clean plate.
Size-select 16 sequencing libraries with a 0.6x / 0.8x double-sided SPRI bead cleanup on the magnetic module and elute in 25 ul elution buffer.

Magnetic bead DNA extraction for 8 lysed samples in a deep well plate on the magnetic module: add 20 ul beads and 400 ul binding buffer, incubate 5 minutes, remove the supernatant, wash twice with 500 ul wash buffer, and elute in 50 ul.

Set up 12 restriction digests, 20 ul each: 2 ul 10x buffer, 1 ul enzyme, 5 ul of a different plasmid per reaction, 12 ul water. Reagents are in tubes on a temperature module at 4 C, reactions go in a PCR plate.

Set up Golden Gate assembly reactions for 8 constructs. Each gets 2 ul of T4 ligase buffer, 1 ul of BsaI, 1 ul of T4 ligase, 1 ul each of 3 part plasmids chosen from a plate of 12 parts (construct n uses parts n, n+1 and n+2), and water to 15 ul.

Transform 8 ligation reactions: add 2 ul of each ligation to 25 ul of competent cells in a PCR plate on the temperature module at 4 C, incubate 20 minutes, then after a manual heat shock pause add 100 ul of SOC medium to each.
Seed a 96-well plate with 100 ul of cell suspension per well from a reservoir, leaving the outer wells filled with 200 ul PBS instead.

Treat cells in a 96-well plate with 6 compounds at 8 concentrations in duplicate: remove 50 ul of medium from each well and add 50 ul of 2x compound dilutions from a prepared compound plate with the same layout.
MTT assay on a 96-well plate of cells: add 10 ul of MTT reagent to every well, wait 3 hours, remove 85 ul of medium from every well to waste, then add 100 ul of DMSO and mix.
Prepare 12 samples for SDS-PAGE: mix 15 ul of each protein sample from a 96-well plate with 5 ul of 4x loading dye from a tube in a PCR plate.
